decisions.reason: A multi-model workstation line built on the established laser offer represents real investment, and it has stayed on the website for two years, so dropping it would write off that commitment.
The thermal inkjet printer is core to the firm's established coding portfolio, has had a dedicated page in both years, and costs little to sustain alongside its consumables business.
The piezo inkjet printer is close to the core offer, is presented on its own page, and fits the strategy of matching technologies to each surface.
This is a publicly announced flagship laser line shown on the home page and central to the firm's direction, so the commitment to keep it is very strong.
The cabin was newly launched with a public 'New' announcement and complements the laser flagship, so any early weak results can still be attributed to the ramp-up phase.
The award-winning lubricant system has gained public recognition that the firm would not want to discredit, and its niche in sheet metal processing justifies persisting with it.
